component.name: Nova Linux
component.summary: Stream your PC games to Linux desktops, laptops and handhelds

description.p: Nova Linux pairs with a Polaris host, shows the games it offers with their artwork, and streams the one you pick with native video, audio and controls. This Alpha targets x86_64 Linux desktops, laptops and handhelds, including Steam Deck. Available codecs, HDR and frame rates depend on the device, drivers, display and host.
